verdict.rationale: Manufact's evidence focuses on deploying, testing, and observing MCP servers, and on exposing its own management functions (deployments, logs, etc.) as MCP tools — there is no mention of an agent-facing meta-tool that lets an AI agent dynamically search and load third-party tools at runtime to avoid context bloat. Missing for 10: any documentation of a tool-search/tool-load meta-tool, dynamic tool discovery API, or context-reduction mechanism for agents consuming many tools.
